#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Modify document.xml to:
1. Add a right-aligned tab stop at position 9360 (right margin) to each paragraph
2. Insert a tab character after the 3rd word in each sentence
"""
import re

with open('/tmp/docx_extract/word/document.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    xml = f.read()

# The run properties block used everywhere
RPR = '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Calibri" w:hAnsi="Calibri" w:cs="Calibri"/><w:color w:val="000000"/></w:rPr>'

# Each paragraph: replace the entire content with a normalized version that has
# the first 3 words, a tab, then the rest. Also add the tab stop to pPr.

# Build replacements. (paraIdHex, original_run_block, first_three_words, rest_text)
# Use the existing visible text and rebuild the run content cleanly.

# Helper to build a fresh paragraph body content (everything after pPr/before </w:p>)
def make_runs(first, rest):
    # first run has first three words; then tab; then rest run
    return (
        f'<w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{first}</w:t></w:r>'
        f'<w:r>{RPR}<w:tab/></w:r>'
        f'<w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{rest}</w:t></w:r>'
    )

# Tab stop block to inject inside pPr right after pStyle
TAB_BLOCK = '<w:tabs><w:tab w:val="right" w:pos="9360"/></w:tabs>'

# List of (paraId, first_three_words, rest_text)
paragraphs = [
    ('3A680B9A', 'Please find the', ' E-book purchase option for your reference:'),
    ('64317D4D', 'How to use', ' BLCUP eBook for PC'),
    ('59A0D8E0', 'Make payment for', ' this eBook online.'),
    ('133A8A87', 'Enter User center', ' (Your BLCUP ID.'),
    ('0AACE46B', 'Download and install', ' Windows eBook Reader (flipviewer) on your PC.'),
    ('4C3904D7', 'Enter User center', ' (Your BLCUP ID.'),
    ('25C38496', 'Download eBook and', ' input Subscription ID online to open the OPZ file.'),
    ('58C22C4F', 'Support Contact: service', ' blcup.com'),
    ('15926053', 'This product is', ' protected by copyright.'),
    ('2C2AA6EC', 'Use only on', ' paying PC.'),
]

for paraId, first, rest in paragraphs:
    # Match the entire <w:p ... w14:paraId="XXX" ... > ... </w:p>
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(<w:p [^>]*w14:paraId="' + paraId + r'"[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:p>)',
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    m = pattern.search(xml)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f'Paragraph {paraId} not found')
    open_tag, body, close_tag = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)

    # Extract pPr and replace its content; then drop existing runs and put fresh ones
    pPr_match = re.search(r'<w:pPr>(.*?)</w:pPr>', body, re.DOTALL)
    if not pPr_match:
        raise SystemExit(f'pPr not found in {paraId}')
    pPr_inner = pPr_match.group(1)

    # Insert tab stop right after pStyle (or at start if no pStyle)
    if '<w:tabs>' in pPr_inner:
        new_pPr_inner = pPr_inner  # already has tabs
    else:
        new_pPr_inner = re.sub(
            r'(<w:pStyle [^/]*/>)',
            r'\1' + TAB_BLOCK,
            pPr_inner,
            count=1,
        )
    new_pPr = f'<w:pPr>{new_pPr_inner}</w:pPr>'
    new_body = new_pPr + make_runs(first, rest)
    new_para = open_tag + new_body + close_tag
    xml = xml[:m.start()] + new_para + xml[m.end():]

with open('/tmp/docx_extract/word/document.xml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(xml)

print('OK')
